overview.title: Product overview
overview.body: RAFT 2.03 is an intelligent financial analysis and forecasting system built for modern enterprises. By combining advanced data analytics with AI, it helps businesses track financial metrics in real time, predict future trends, and generate professional reports — making financial management simpler and more efficient. Whether you're a startup or an established corporation, RAFT 2.03 delivers tailored financial solutions to help you navigate the business landscape with confidence.

reports.desc: One-click, standards-compliant reports — income statements, balance sheets, cash flow — exportable to PDF or Excel.
